# LIV NEXT Saudi 2027

> LIV NEXT Saudi 2027 (also written LIVNEXT Saudi) is a B2B exhibition and summit in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, in 2027. It connects developers, asset owners, operators, industries and public-sector stakeholders around quality of life and better places to live. It is organised by Connect Spot Exhibitions, Riyadh. Exact dates and venue have not been announced on this site yet.

Not to be confused with LIV Golf or other businesses with similar names.

## Pages

- [Home](https://livnextsaudi.com/): what the event is and who it is for
- [About](https://livnextsaudi.com/about): the purpose and audience of the exhibition and summit
- [Sectors](https://livnextsaudi.com/sectors): six sectors: smart living, healthcare, public mobility, education, culture and sustainability, with who will exhibit and who will visit
- [Programme](https://livnextsaudi.com/programme): indicative themes for the three-day summit
- [Exhibit](https://livnextsaudi.com/exhibit): developer showcases, solution showcases and open business networking
- [Sponsor](https://livnextsaudi.com/sponsor): partnership levels (Presenting Development Partner, Title / Founding Partner, Sector Partner, Experience Partner)
- [Contact and exhibitor enquiry](https://livnextsaudi.com/contact): enquiry form for exhibiting, sponsoring or visiting

## Contact
